name: Ildong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Ildong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products in South Korea. The company offers active lactic acid bacterial and anti-diarrheal agents, antibiotics, antifungal and antiviral products, anti-cancer, antineoplastic agents, and NSAIDs and analgesics, as well as vitamins, minerals, and nutrients; and drugs for blood circulation, cardiovascular and central nervous system, dental, endocrine and metabolic system, gastrointestinal system, respiratory system, and urogenital system applications.
